fusions.name: Hoofbeat Drive
fusions.desc: Your next 2 weapon strikes each deal 12 blunt damage, knock the enemy 2.5 tiles back and leave it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Trample Through
fusions.desc: A trampling blow that deals 28 blunt damage, always lands as a critical hit and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Steady Pace
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Not Yet Spent
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, 20 stamina comes back to you. Once every 25 seconds.
